answer: Deposits are visible in voyage, and jade reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 30% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 64 aliases, and each one needs its own funded shale account. A farm of 4422 identities would post 1157 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
